allies.rationale_text: Systems-thinking helps risk-assessment see interdependencies and unknown-unknowns before the downside is misread as a set of isolated variables.
allies.affinity_rationale: Canonical: 'Risk assessment is fundamentally supported by systems thinking, which enables the perception of the system as a whole, rather than isolated facts.'
allies.activation_condition: When risk assessment requires viewing the business as an integrated ecosystem to uncover interdependencies and unknown unknowns.

allies.rationale_text: Constraints help risk-assessment identify the bottlenecks and exposure limits that most shape downside behavior under pressure.
allies.affinity_rationale: Moderate: understanding constraints shapes the boundary conditions within which risks must be assessed. Not directly in canonical allies.
allies.activation_condition: When risk assessment must account for constraints that define the boundaries and limitations of possible mitigation strategies.

allies.rationale_text: Checklists give risk-assessment a disciplined surface for thresholds, mitigations, and monitoring so key exposures are not left to memory.
allies.affinity_rationale: Moderate: checklists provide systematic coverage of risk factors, reducing the chance of omission. Practical assessment tool.
allies.activation_condition: When systematic enumeration of risk factors is needed to ensure comprehensive coverage and prevent oversight.

antagonists.rationale_text: Optimism-bias-and-planning-fallacy undermines risk-assessment when downside scenarios are underweighted because the plan feels internally coherent and success feels conjunctively plausible.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Canonical: 'the general tendency to overestimate the probability of conjunctive events leads to unwarranted optimism in evaluating plan success.'
antagonists.activation_condition: When optimistic assumptions about sequential success probabilities lead to underestimation of overall project risk.

antagonists.rationale_text: Representativeness-bias undermines risk-assessment by causing estimators to judge likelihood based on how much a situation resembles a vivid past case rather than on distributional base rates — salient analogies displace the reference-class evidence risk assessment requires.
antagonists.source_quote: risk-assessment vs representativeness-heuristic: risk-assessment conflicts with representativeness-heuristic (representativeness bias) when salient analogies replace distributional risk estimates.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Curated tension: 'salient analogies replace distributional risk estimates' — surface resemblance overrides proper statistical risk quantification.
antagonists.activation_condition: When vivid analogies to past successes override the distributional analysis needed for accurate risk estimation.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Risk-assessment conflicts with optimism-bias-and-planning-fallacy when downside scenarios are underweighted.
structured_tensions.source_quote: risk-assessment vs optimism-bias-and-planning-fallacy: risk-assessment conflicts with optimism-bias-and-planning-fallacy (optimism bias and planning fallacy) when downside scenarios are underweighted.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Risk-assessment conflicts with representativeness-heuristic when salient analogies replace distributional risk estimates — the vivid similarity of a situation to a past case overrides the reference-class base rates that accurate risk quantification requires.
structured_tensions.source_quote: risk-assessment vs representativeness-heuristic: risk-assessment conflicts with representativeness-heuristic (representativeness bias) when salient analogies replace distributional risk estimates.

curation_notes.summary: Layer 1+2 enrichment complete. systems-thinking 0.90 ('fundamentally supported'), constraints and checklists at 0.80. optimism-bias antagonist at 0.90, representativeness at 0.80.
donor_drops: Did not preserve donor risk-framework widening beyond the clearly named systems, controls, and anti-optimism neighborhood.
